description: Frozen configuration for MODIS MCD12Q1 label harmonization and quarantine rules for Phase 4 Track 4.1.

decision_thresholds.quarantine_rule: When max_{c in M} w_i(c) < 0.20 across all 13 mapped classes, the patch is strictly quarantined as Inevaluable and excluded from the evaluable cohort N_evaluable.
decision_thresholds.zero_ground_truth_policy: Samples where no mapped class reaches >= 0.20 are quarantined and NEVER assigned an artificial, zero, or fallback mapped label.

quarantined_classes.rationale: Sub-pixel parcel geometries, industrial/commercial separation from residential fabric, and orchard/vineyard distinctions cannot be resolved from 500m MODIS IGBP Class 13/12
